title: Dual authorisation bypassed on the urgent-payment path
condition: 6 of 30 sampled urgent / manual payments (incl. 2 over GBP 25k) were released with a single approver
criteria: Payments over GBP 25k require two authorisers (Authorisation Matrix v4, control C-01/C-04)
cause: The urgent-payment workflow does not system-enforce a second authoriser; reliance is on manual discipline
consequence: Unauthorised or fraudulent payments can be released; this is the same gap implicated in the Q1 2026 near-miss
recommendation: System-enforce dual authorisation on the urgent path with no manual override; reconcile urgent payments daily to approvals
management_response: Agreed. System control to be configured; interim daily reconciliation from 2026-06-09

title: Three-way-match override permitted without justification
condition: Override reason was blank for 9% of overridden invoices (47 of 521 overrides); no monitoring of override usage
criteria: Overrides should be justified and monitored (COSO information & monitoring; firm policy FIN-07)
cause: Override reason field is not mandatory and no exception report is reviewed
consequence: Inaccurate or duplicate payments may pass undetected; control reliance is overstated
recommendation: Make the override reason mandatory; introduce a monthly review of all overrides by the Financial Controller
management_response: Agreed. Mandatory field by 2026-07-15; monthly review commences July

title: Supplier bank-detail changes not consistently verified
condition: 3 of 20 sampled bank-detail changes had no evidence of an independent verification / call-back
criteria: Bank-detail changes require independent verification before activation (maker-checker, control C-03)
cause: Manual process; the second check is not enforced or evidenced in the system
consequence: Payments could be diverted to fraudulent accounts
recommendation: Enforce and evidence maker-checker on bank-detail changes within the supplier master workflow
